scope: Two targeted search/fetch pairs, not a sampled reliability study or safeguard evaluation
prior_exposure: Earlier AN and MH locator summaries were known. Targets are purposive rechecks; not blind or confirmatory.

queries.query: Antiqua et Nova paragraph 44 ultimate responsibility human decision-makers accountability each stage
Magnifica Humanitas paragraph 105 artificial intelligence human responsibility accountability

selection_rule: Use the first result for the exact requested document and paragraph; if no exact locator exists, record target_not_returned and fetch no substitute.
retry_policy: No retries or automatic repairs; all returned failures retained.
checks: fetch textual paragraph identity against official Vatican text
public_export: Exact request and metadata fields, tool-returned text length and hash, short permitted excerpt at most 20 words per primary document; full text withheld pending rights review.
capture_boundary: Application-level tool request/response visible to assistant; no provider transport logs or provider timestamp claims.
review: No independent human or theological reviewer; no canonical CEC admission.
